cards.mood: The piece opens with an urgent, high-tension instrumental drive that immediately establishes a sense of frantic motion.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, down-tuned electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and rhythmic engine, utilizing palm-muted chugging patterns in the verses and open, soaring power chords in the choruses.
